propositions: Rebar's security assurance model targets FISMA Moderate certification, defined as process-followed plus no-blocking-issues, explicitly not a correctness guarantee.

Five accepted security limitations (L1-L5) must be documented with bounding controls and authority tiers: L1 key-validity-rests-on-access-control, L2 no-transparency-log, L3 TOFU-authorship, L4 single-environment/no-threshold, L5 process-not-correctness.
The ADR must include prior-art benchmarking against gittuf, TUF, Sigstore, in-toto/SLSA, RFC 8725, NIST SP 800-218, and NIST SP 800-53.
Deferred-hardening items must reference tracked idea tickets 2422, 4e1d, and 5100.
ADR 0046 must land on main via Gerrit with Verified +1 and LLM-Review +1 approvals.
